{{Quote|I would ask Intell to dispatch Agent Clanson and any other willing operatives so that they may accompany those of us who intend to confront Barosa at the upcoming Secure Passage seminar on Dlor 3.|Addendum by Major Sisquoc to Rebel Alliance [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on Barosa Warren|<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dononter sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that contained the [[Dlor system/Legends|Dlor]] and [[Dononter Minor system/Legends|Dononter Minor systems]]. The former contained the astronomical object [[Dlor 3]], and the latter contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Dononter Minor]], which was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Widowmaker (plant)|widowmaker]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. In addition, the [[Spar Trade Route/Legends|Spar Trade Route]] traveled through the sector.

Dlor 3 was the scheduled site of the [[Secure Passage seminar]] around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. [[4 ABY/Legends|Two years]] later, the forces of the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Nagai–Tof War|invaders]] moved along the section of the Spar Trade Route traveling through the Dononter sector.

==Description==
The Dononter [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Marzoon sector/Legends|Marzoon sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[Corbett sector/Legends|Corbett]] and [[Semagi sector/Legends|Semagi sectors]] [[spinward]], and the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] of the Mid Rim in the [[trailing]] direction. The sector also formed a part of the Mid Rim's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] border with the Outer Rim Territories' [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen]] and [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sectors]].<ref name="Mid Rim" />

The Dononter sector contained the [[Dlor system/Legends|Dlor system]] and the [[Dononter Minor system/Legends|Dononter Minor system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Spar Trade Route/Legends|Spar Trade Route]] traveled through the sector,<ref name="Spar" /> connecting the [[Cerean system]] in the Semagi sector to the Zuma sector's [[Abbaji system/Legends|Abbaji system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
While moving Rimward as part of secondary movements of their [[Nagai–Tof War|separate invasions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the forces of the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]] traveled along<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the section of the Spar Trade Route passing through the Dononter sector.<ref name="Spar" />

==Locations==
The Dlor [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained<ref name="EAOC" /> the terrestrial astronomical object [[Dlor 3]],<ref name="AIR" /> and the Dononter Minor system hosted<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Dononter Minor]], which had a breathable Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The latter was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] known as the [[Widowmaker (plant)|widowmaker]], which could be used as a weapon.<ref name="Endor" />

Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Secure Passage seminar]] was scheduled to take place on Dlor 3. [[Barosa Warren]], a [[Morellian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and the founder of the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]], planned to attend the seminar. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Sisquoc]] and other Alliance members who were formerly Warren's students at the Galactic Outdoor Survival School planned to confront the Morellian, who held a grudge against Sisquoc in particular and the Alliance in general, at the summit on Dlor 3.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dononter sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2011]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://web.archive.org/web/20120117150257/https://www.starwars.com/atlas/midrim/index.html Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]," which placed it in grid squares H-16, I-16, and I-17.<ref name="MidRimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=atlas/midrim/index.html|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref>
